gen-gf-phudu-gf-barlow: Barlow keeps its curves open, the tips of its c pulled well apart, with a stroke like a neon tube, and Phudu stands over it as the louder voice. Text in it moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-biz-udgothic: Friendly and bold, Phudu draws its heading in a plain, pressure-free line with open curve endings. BIZ UDGothic follows with wide channels into every bowl and a low thick-thin swing, so it stays quietly legible.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-biz-udpgothic: Phudu draws its uppercase from lines of one constant thickness. BIZ UDPGothic lets its letters spread out generously with clear channels into each round shape, and the two feel like a loud voice next to a relaxed one.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-bpmf-huninn: Phudu leads with generous curve openings and a plain, ballpoint-like line. Bpmf Huninn answers in a single-weight outline feel with wide channels into every bowl, so the two sit like a shout beside a modern, easygoing murmur.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std keeps its counters connected to the outside and swells only slightly in its curves, while Phudu above it draws a steady, marker-like line. They fit together comfortably.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-cairo: Chunky, open-curved lettering from Phudu, whose diagonals match its stems in weight. Cairo follows with wide channels into every bowl and a low thick-thin swing, which gives the heading plenty of room to be loud.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-cairo-play: Pen-nib roundness, bold and distinctive: Phudu looks drawn by a fixed-width nib, and Cairo Play below it keeps its open round letters clear at small sizes. Reading it goes down easily.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-cambay: Round, bold and a touch odd, Phudu gives each stroke the same visual weight and leaves its curve ends open. Cambay comes after with rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, so the two feel like a loud grin beside a quiet nod.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-cantarell: Cantarell pulls the tips of its c shapes well apart and gives r, n and m arches that match their stems. And Phudu is the one that grabs attention, where Cantarell is built to be read.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-catamaran: Catamaran has curvy letters that feel unclamped, a loose and approachable body voice. Phudu above it has rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord, and Catamaran carries on in a softer, lower-contrast way.
